claim: “The degree determiners can also function directly as predicative complement: Their enemies were many.”
evidence_summary: Determiner is CGEL’s name for a function. The sentence concerns items outside that function. The section title and the book’s other uses say degree determinatives.
finding: Replace determiners with determinatives. This is the only occurrence of degree determiners in the book.
proposed_wording: The degree determinatives can also function directly as predicative complement
inference: Does the sentence keep category and function distinct?

evidence.example: Search of the whole text layer for degree determiners returns this sentence only.
evidence.establishes: A category–function slip in one sentence.
